mechanism: Galantamine (cholinesterase inhibitor) may potentiate parasympathomimetic effects and brimonidine (alpha-2 agonist) has CNS penetration that could enhance cholinergic activity, increasing risk of bradycardia and hypotension.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure; assess for syncope or excessive bradycardia; consider alternative ophthalmic agent if cardiovascular effects emerge.
